# BI Connector - (current)

> Query MongoDB data with SQL using the Connector for BI to integrate with tools like Tableau, Power BI, and Excel.

- [Enable BI Connector in Atlas](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/atlas-bi-connector.md): Enable MongoDB Connector for Business Intelligence in MongoDB Atlas, Cloud Manager, or Ops Manager
- [Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/authentication.md): Configure authentication for the MongoDB BI Connector using mechanisms like SCRAM, LDAP, and Kerberos, and learn how to set up client authentication.
- [Connect BI Tools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/client-applications.md): Connect BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, and Excel to BI Connector using ODBC and JDBC drivers.
- [MongoDB Connector for BI Components](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/components.md): Explore the tools and drivers available for the MongoDB Connector for BI, including `mongodrdl`, `mongosqld`, and various authentication plugins.
- [Connect from Microsoft Excel](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/excel.md): Import data from a MongoDB collection into Microsoft Excel using the MongoDB Connector for BI and an ODBC data connection.
- [Connect from Looker](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/looker.md)
- [Connect from MicroStrategy Desktop](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/microstrategy.md)
- [Connect from the MySQL Client](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/mysql.md): Connect to the MongoDB Connector for BI using the MySQL client with options for authentication and TLS/SSL.
- [Connect from Microsoft Power BI Desktop](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/powerbi.md): Connect to the MongoDB Connector for BI using Microsoft Power BI Desktop by setting up an ODBC Data Source Name and selecting your data.
- [Connect from Qlik Sense](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/qlik.md): Learn to connect Qlik Sense to MongoDB Connector for BI by creating a 64-bit system DSN and setting up a new app.
- [Connect from Spotfire Cloud](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/spotfire-cloud.md)
- [Connect from Tableau Desktop with Authentication and TLS/SSL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/tableau-auth-ssl.md): Connect Tableau Desktop to the MongoDB Connector for BI using authentication and TLS/SSL by configuring a system DSN with the ODBC driver.
- [Connect from Tableau Desktop with Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/tableau-auth.md): Connect Tableau Desktop to MongoDB BI Connector with authentication. Set up a system DSN using the ODBC driver and configure secure connection parameters.
- [Connect from Tableau Desktop without Authentication or TLS/SSL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/tableau-no-auth.md): Connect Tableau Desktop to MongoDB BI Connector without authentication or TLS/SSL by setting up a system DSN using the ODBC driver.
- [Connect from Tableau Desktop](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/connect/tableau.md): Find instructions to connect Tableau Desktop to MongoDB instances with or without authentication and TLS/SSL.
- [FAQ: The MongoDB Connector for BI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/faq.md): Find answers to common questions about the MongoDB Connector for BI, including authentication, data processing, and using TLS/SSL.
- [What is the MongoDB Connector for BI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/index.md): Query MongoDB data with SQL using the Connector for BI to integrate with tools like Tableau, Power BI, and Excel.
- [Install BI Connector On Premises](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/installation.md): Install the BI Connector on premises with platform-specific guides for Windows, macOS, RHEL-based, and Debian-based systems.
- [Launch BI Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/launch.md): Launch the BI Connector using `mongosqld` to connect MongoDB to BI tools, with options for schema creation and running as a service.
- [Quick Start Guide for Windows](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/local-quickstart.md): Set up the BI Connector on Windows using ODBC, including starting `mongod` and `mongosqld` processes, installing the driver, and connecting with a BI tool.
- [Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference.md): Find reference materials for the BI Connector.
- [MySQL Shell Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/auth-plugin-c-mysql-options.md): Explore MySQL command-line options for use with the C Authentication Plugin, `mongosql_auth`, including user authentication and plugin directory settings.
- [C Authentication Plugin](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/auth-plugin-c.md): Install and use the C Authentication Plugin for MongoDB BI Connector to authenticate with various mechanisms like SCRAM-SHA and LDAP.
- [JDBC Authentication Plugin](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/auth-plugin-jdbc.md): Integrate MySQL's Connector/J JDBC driver with MongoDB BI Connector using the `mongosql_auth` plugin for various authentication mechanisms.
- [Document Relational Definition Language](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/drdl.md): Define a relational view of a MongoDB schema using Document Relational Definition Language (DRDL) to enable MySQL clients to query MongoDB data.
- [MySQL JDBC Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/jdbc-driver.md): Use the MySQL Connector/J version 5.1.x for JDBC connectivity with the BI Connector, with a minimum supported version of 5.1.44.
- [Known Issues for MongoDB Connector for BI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/known-issues.md): Understand the known issues with SQL compatibility and mapping errors in the BI Connector, including differences in handling `NULL` values and empty sets.
- [Log Messages](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/log-messages.md): Understand the format and components of `mongosqld` log messages, including severity levels, components, and how to configure log verbosity.
- [``mongodrdl``](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/mongodrdl.md): Learn how to use mongodrdl to generate relational schemas from MongoDB collections, and upload, download, or delete DRDL schema files for the BI Connector.
- [``mongosqld``](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/mongosqld.md): Configure and run mongosqld to proxy SQL queries to MongoDB using the BI Connector. Covers command-line options, TLS, authentication, and schema management.
- [``mongotranslate``](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/mongotranslate.md): The mongotranslate reference page.
- [MongoDB BI Connector ODBC Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/odbc-driver.md): Connect SQL clients to the BI Connector using the MongoDB BI Connector ODBC Driver, compatible with various platforms and supporting authentication mechanisms.
- [System Variables](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/system-variables.md): Explore the system variables available for BI Connector, including their data types, descriptions, and default values, and learn how to set them.
- [Type Conversion Modes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/type-conversion.md): Configure type conversion modes in the BI Connector to optimize SQL query translation into MongoDB aggregation pipelines, enhancing performance.
- [User Authorization Model](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/reference/user-authorization.md): Understand the user authorization model for the BI Connector, mapping SQL statements and MySQL privileges to required MongoDB privileges.
- [Release Notes for MongoDB Connector for BI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/release-notes.md): Explore the latest updates and improvements in the MongoDB Connector for BI, including new features, bug fixes, and compatibility changes for each release.
- [Map Relational Schemas to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema-configuration.md): Map relational schemas to MongoDB using BI Connector, which provides methods for creating and managing relational schemas for business intelligence tools.
- [Standalone Schema Mode (Cached Sampling)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema/cached-sampling.md): Learn how to use cached sampling in standalone schema mode with `mongosqld`, including setting user permissions and configuring schema refresh intervals.
- [Geospatial Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema/geospatial-data.md): Understand how BI Connector maps geospatial indexes into numeric longitude-latitude arrays in MongoDB collections.
- [Load a Schema from a DRDL File](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema/load-schema-from-drdl.md): Load and edit a schema from a DRDL file for use with BI Connector, and apply changes by restarting `mongosqld`.
- [Auto Schema Mode (Persist a Schema in MongoDB)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema/persist-schema.md): Persist a schema in MongoDB using `mongosqld` with options for schema storage, automatic resampling, and user permissions.
- [Resample Schema Data with "FLUSH SAMPLE"](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema/resample-schema.md): Regenerate the schema used by BI Connector with the `FLUSH SAMPLE` command or by restarting `mongosqld` to accommodate significant data shape changes.
- [Schema Management Changes in 2.11](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema/schema-management-changes.md): Update your BI Connector configuration to version 2.11 for improved schema management, with changes in standalone, custom, and auto modes.
- [Sampling Type Conflicts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema/type-conflicts.md): Resolve type conflicts in MongoDB fields using BI Connector by sampling data and generating relational schemas for scalar and composite types.
- [Use MongoDB Views](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/schema/use-views.md): Use views to control data visibility for BI Connector, allowing field selection, renaming, sorting, and transformations without a .drdl file.
- [Supported SQL Functions and Operators](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/supported-operations.md): Explore the supported SQL functions, operators, and statements in the MongoDB Connector for BI, including comparison, logical, and string functions.
- [Create a System DSN](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/tutorial/create-system-dsn.md): Create a system DSN for the BI Connector's `mongosqld` process to configure SQL clients and BI tools for MongoDB data import.
- [Install BI Connector on Debian-based Linux](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/tutorial/install-bi-connector-debian.md): Install the BI Connector on Debian-based Linux to integrate MongoDB with business intelligence tools like Tableau, following the provided setup steps.
- [Install BI Connector on macOS](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/tutorial/install-bi-connector-macos.md): Install the MongoDB BI Connector on macOS to connect MongoDB with business intelligence tools like Tableau, including prerequisites and configuration steps.
- [Install BI Connector on Red Hat Enterprise-based Linux](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/tutorial/install-bi-connector-rhel.md): Install the BI Connector on Red Hat Enterprise Linux to integrate MongoDB with business intelligence tools like Tableau.
- [Install BI Connector on Windows](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/tutorial/install-bi-connector-windows.md): Set up the BI Connector on Windows for use with business intelligence tools like Tableau by following installation and configuration steps.
- [Configure Kerberos for BI Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/tutorial/kerberos.md): Configure Kerberos authentication for the BI Connector to connect BI tools and authenticate with MongoDB on Windows, Linux, and macOS systems.
- [Configure TLS for BI Connector](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/tutorial/ssl-setup.md): Set up TLS encryption for BI Connector by creating self-signed certificates and configuring MongoDB components for secure data transmission.
- [What is the MongoDB Connector for BI?](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/bi-connector/current/what-is-the-bi-connector.md): Enable SQL-based queries on MongoDB data using the BI Connector to integrate with relational business intelligence tools like Tableau and Power BI.
